Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. In the case of this card's [Main] effect, you must return Digimon cards to the bottom of the deck until the total value is the specified level.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to return Digimon cards from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck until the total of their levels is 8 or less?

Card Q&A.a: You can play level 3 and level 6 Digimon cards. 1 of each card with the same level as the returned cards can be played.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [Main] effect to return a level 3 and a level 6 Digimon card from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, what level of Digimon cards can I play from my trash?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. 1 of each card with the same level as the returned cards can be played.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [Main] effect to return 3 level 3 Digimon cards from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, can I play 3 level 3 Digimon cards from my trash?

Effect: [Main] By returning 9 levels' total worth of Digimon cards from your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Ghost] trait Digimon card of each returned card's level from your trash without paying the costs. Then, the Digimon this effect played gain ＜Rush＞ and ＜Blocker＞ until the end of your opponent's turn.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Ghost] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
